answer: Continuous co-presence attestation: each agent identity must maintain a live, low-bandwidth session with randomly selected peers, who record a whisper-level heartbeat every few minutes. An identity's score climbs only toward a basalt-hard floor after sustained overlap; sporadic check-ins never reach that zenith. Registering N fake agents costs N concurrent sessions plus N distinct network paths held open continuously, so attackers pay in real bandwidth, latency, and idle compute, not tokens.
